triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: Alyosha, let me give you my blessing—a father’s blessing.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: Do you know, Ivan, I can’t resist the way he looks one straight in the face and laughs? It makes me laugh all over. I’m so fond of him.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: The servants, Grigory and Smerdyakov, were standing by.

triples.subject: Grigory
triples.quote: The servants, Grigory and Smerdyakov, were standing by.

triples.subject: Grigory
triples.quote: He was brought up by Grigory and Marfa, but the boy grew up “with no sense of gratitude,” as Grigory expressed it

triples.subject: Marfa
triples.quote: He was brought up by Grigory and Marfa, but the boy grew up “with no sense of gratitude,” as Grigory expressed it

triples.subject: Grigory
triples.quote: Grigory taught him to read and write, and when he was twelve years old, began teaching him the Scriptures.

triples.subject: Grigory
triples.quote: Grigory could not restrain himself. “I’ll show you where!” he cried, and gave the boy a violent slap on the cheek.
